IntegrityNext is the supply chain sustainability intelligence & orchestration platform that embeds sustainability into the operating model of your supply chain, allowing you to align sustainability goals with business outcomes across the supply chain and shift from reactive to proactive strategy execution.

Automate the work that slows sustainability down - supplier data collection, assessments, compliance checks, and reporting - so teams spend less time chasing inputs and more time executing. AI-assisted assessments plus automated product compliance workflows reduce manual effort while keeping outputs audit-ready.
Proactive Risk Mitigation​

Turn sustainability and compliance signals into early warnings and clear next steps, before issues become disruptions, fines, or reputational hits. A governed risk layer continuously evaluates supplier and product signals, applies expert prioritization, and triggers alerts, assessments, and actions with humans in control.​
Improved Supplier Performance​

Improve supplier performance with risk-based, data-driven engagement that focuses effort where it matters most, reducing supplier fatigue. Prioritize suppliers intelligently, target outreach with evidence-backed insights, and drive measurable progress across your supplier base.​

Connect sustainability execution to outcomes: efficiency, cost, risk reduction, resilience, and growth. Track progress across suppliers and products, build an ROI narrative that stands up to stakeholder scrutiny.​

Explore our comprehensive suite of solutions designed to help you meet global sustainability demands across every aspect of your supply chain. From due diligence to decarbonization, we empower you to drive positive impact while staying ahead of evolving regulatory requirements.
Sustainable Procurement

Embed sustainability into procurement decisions across the entire supplier lifecycle. IntegrityNext helps you identify risks, engage suppliers in improvement plans, and integrate sustainability into sourcing, contracting, and supplier management—turning procurement into a driver of sustainability impact and business value.

Meet growing due diligence obligations under laws like the EU Supply Chain Act (CSDDD), Germany’s Supply Chain Act, France’s Duty of Vigilance Law, and more. IntegrityNext enables end-to-end compliance by identifying environmental and human rights risks, engaging suppliers, and providing multi-tier transparency and audit-ready documentation.
Forced Labor Prevention

Prevent forced labor-linked goods from entering your supply chain. IntegrityNext enables compliance with laws like the UFLPA and upcoming EU Forced Labor Regulation through supplier screening, traceability, and risk-based due diligence—so you can take credible, proactive action to protect your business, ensure responsible sourcing, and uphold human rights.

Measure, track, and reduce emissions across your supply chain. IntegrityNext helps you collect company- and product-level carbon data, engage suppliers on reduction targets, and ensure compliance with frameworks like SBTi and regulations like CBAM—accelerating climate action and Scope 3 reduction at scale.

Ensure compliance with ESG and product-level regulations on EUDR, conflict minerals, hazardous substances, chemicals, batteries, and more. IntegrityNext automates supplier data collection and streamlines reporting—reducing administrative burden while safeguarding market access.

Streamline your non-financial reporting with structured ESG data and automated disclosures. IntegrityNext provides end-to-end CSRD compliance, automated GRI reporting, and ISSB alignment—covering double materiality and value chain impacts to meet today’s sustainability reporting expectations.

Lower-tier supply chains are rife with ESG risks, including forced labor, poor working conditions, and weak environmental standards in mining and metal production.
Phasing Out Hazardous Chemicals and Ensuring Product Safety

The widespread use of hazardous chemicals in manufacturing poses risks to worker safety and environmental health. Advanced ESG platforms support compliance with safety standards and regulations, facilitate the shift to safer alternatives, and ensure product safety throughout the value chain, including the use phase.

Sustainable supply chain practices not only mitigate risks but also provide a competitive edge in customer bids and contracting processes. ESG tools empower manufacturers to align supply chains with sustainability goals, enhancing resilience while creating positive downstream impacts for customers.
